text: Si wanaa ɓen ɓe hino jokkoo e maɓɓe faade yimɓe ɓe ahodiɗon tertagol hare, maaɗum ɓe arii on hara ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen hino faaɗani haɓugol on, maa haɓugol yimɓe maɓɓe ɓen. Si Alla Haajuno, O Warayno ɓe e mooɗon, ɓe haɓa on. Wata on haɓu ɓe maa dahon. Si ɓe pottitike on, ɓe haɓaali on, ɓe arii e mon fii moƴƴintingol, haray dey Alla Waɗanaali on e dow maɓɓe laawol haɓugol ɓe maa dahugol ɓe.
